about: Synthetic postings for the Job Scout demo and eval. Companies are fictional; URLs use the reserved example.com domain. Six companies also appear in the jobmail sample inbox, so a role Scout emails in v1 can be traced to the application it became in v2. 'expect' lists the digest tiers a careful human would accept (strong, look, long, or drop for a hard reject); 'why' records the judgment behind the label.

postings.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Platform
postings.description: Northbeam builds marketing measurement for mid-market brands. You will own our AI platform: the models, prompts and context that power automated insights for 4,000 customers. You will define how we evaluate LLM output quality, run discovery with customers and data science, set the roadmap, and decide model selection trade-offs on cost and quality. You will partner with engineering on evals, golden sets and release gates. 6+ years of product management in B2B SaaS, experience shipping AI/ML products. Base salary range: $195,000 - $235,000.
postings.why: AI output quality and evals is exactly the candidate's current work; remote; comp above floor.

postings.title: Staff Product Manager, Clinical Data
postings.description: Halcyon Health is building the data platform behind care navigation. As Staff PM you will own clinical data ingestion and the internal tools our care teams use every day. Set strategy and roadmap, lead discovery with clinicians and operations, and work with ML engineers on data quality. Hybrid in our Boston office two days a week. 8+ years of product experience, platform or data product background. Salary: $190,000 - $225,000.
postings.why: Staff level, platform and internal tools, Boston hybrid two days. Healthcare domain is new to him, so look is defensible.

postings.title: Principal Product Manager, Developer Platform
postings.description: Quarry Labs makes infrastructure for AI agents. Our developer platform is how 30,000 developers build, test and evaluate agentic workflows. You will own platform strategy end to end, from zero to one features to pricing and packaging, and lead product discovery with developers. You understand LLMs, tool use and context engineering, and you can talk evals with engineers. Compensation: $210,000 - $250,000 base plus equity.
postings.why: Principal, agent platform, evals and context engineering, remote, strong comp.

postings.title: Staff Product Manager, Fleet Intelligence

Base pay range $185,000 - $215,000.
postings.why: Staff, ML product, remote, comp fine, but robotics hardware experience is a stated preference he lacks.

postings.title: Senior Product Manager - Digital Banking

postings.title: Staff Product Manager, AI Assistants

You will define evaluation methods with our applied AI team, choose between models on quality and cost, and design how customer context reaches the model. B2B SaaS and generative AI product experience. $205,000 - $240,000 base.

postings.title: Senior Product Manager, AI
